claims.head: Second night of a back-to-back for the Red Wings
claims.body: The Red Wings played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Canadiens to control more of the play than they usually do.
claims.call: The Canadiens get a bigger share of the 5-on-5 chances than they usually do.

claims.head: Special teams lean toward the Red Wings
claims.call: The Red Wings’ power play creates at least their usual 8.7 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Canadiens’ penalty kill is near the bottom of the league, and the Red Wings’ power play is one of the best. Discipline matters more than usual for the Canadiens tonight. The Canadiens take a lot of penalties and the Red Wings draw plenty of them, so their power play should get its chances.

MTL.head: The matchup suits the Canadiens
MTL.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Detroit is on the second night of a back-to-back, while Montréal has home-ice advantage. The Red Wings can make it interesting if their power play gets going.
